use default

let bands =
    [(0.06D, 0.10D), (0.11D, 0.18D), (0.16D, 0.26D), (0.21D, 0.32D),
     (0.26D, 0.38D), (0.31D, 0.44D), (0.36D, 0.50D), (0.41D, 0.54D),
     (0.46D, 0.58D), (0.51D, 0.62D), (0.56D, 0.66D), (0.61D, 0.70D),
     (0.66D, 0.74D), (0.71D, 0.78D), (0.76D, 0.82D), (0.81D, 0.86D),
     (0.86D, 0.90D), (0.91D, 0.94D), (0.96D, 0.98D), (1.01D, 1.00D)]

rescale(price: double) -> double =>
    assert price >= 0.0D /\ price < 1.01D else "price out of range" in
    (for (upper_bound, fraction) in bands do
         if price < upper_bound then break fraction fi
     od)!

let shown =
    (0::100) |> map(hundredths => (
        let price = cast(hundredths) / 100.0D

        "{price:F2} -> {rescale(price):F2}"
    ))
    |> collect_list()

for row in 0..21 do
    let last = System.Math.min(row * 5 + 5, shown.count)

    write_line(shown[row * 5..last] |> join("   "))
